cited_passage: ABA Model Rules of Professional Conduct, Rule 1.1 (Competence — including duty to keep abreast of relevant technology and its benefits and risks); Rule 3.3(a)(1) (Candor toward the tribunal — prohibition on making false statements of law to a court); Rules 5.1 and 5.3 (Responsibilities regarding nonlawyers and support staff, extended to AI tools under FO 512). Source: americanbar.org.
